techStack: React 19, TypeScript ~5.7.2, Vite 6 — build command is `tsc -b && vite build` (type-check first, then bundle)
Vitest 3 + jsdom + @testing-library/react — test command is `vitest run`
JSX transform: react-jsx (automatic) — no `import React` needed in JSX files
verbatimModuleSyntax: true — type-only imports must use `import type`
noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters enabled — any introduced dead code will fail the build
noEmit: true in tsconfig — TypeScript only type-checks; Vite handles transpilation
Vitest globals enabled — no need to import describe/it/expect in test files
features: App.tsx: main catalog page — manages filter state, pagination, API fetch, renders ProductList + SortSelect + FilterPanel
ProductCard.tsx: renders a single product card; shows a discount badge when discountPct is non-null; calls formatPrice with the discount value
SortSelect.tsx: <select> dropdown that calls onChange prop with the chosen sort key
ProductList.tsx: purely presentational — accepts `products: Product[]` and renders ProductCard for each

Tests covering: initial render (app.render.test.tsx), sorting (sorting.test.tsx), filtering (filtering.test.tsx), clear-filters (clearFilters.test.tsx), pagination (pagination.test.tsx), loading/error states (loadingError.test.tsx)
No test files may be modified per constraints
architecture: src/types/product.ts defines Product type with `discountPct?: number` (not discountPercent)
src/styles/style.css EXISTS at the correct path
src/styles.css does NOT exist — the wrong import path in App.tsx causes a build failure
ProductList props: `{ products: Product[] }` — no other props; self-closing tag is valid
Components live in src/components/; hooks in src/hooks/; utils in src/utils/; types in src/types/
edgeCases: ProductCard.tsx line 9: `product.discountPercent != null` uses loose inequality — intentionally catches both null and undefined for the optional field; must not be changed to strict inequality when renaming to discountPct
ProductCard.tsx line 25: badge text interpolation `{product.discountPercent}%` — rename only, no logic change
ProductCard.tsx line 37: `formatPrice(product.price, product.discountPercent)` — rename only, function signature unchanged
SortSelect.tsx line 16: `e.target.value` at runtime will always be one of the four option values; the cast `as FilterState['sortBy']` is type-safe even though TypeScript cannot verify it statically
App.tsx line 47: closing `/>` must not add or remove any props — only add the self-closing slash before the angle bracket
Requirement 6 forbids any changes beyond the four targeted lines — no refactoring, no additional files
